sentences.text: A fox runs through a forest away from a bear
A race car speeds through a dark forest
A squirrel jumps over logs in a forest
A monkey runs through the jungle away from a tiger
A jeep races through the jungle
A frog jumps between platforms in the jungle
A lizard runs through the desert away from a snake
A buggy races across the desert
A camel jumps over cactus in the desert
A dog runs through the city away from a dogcatcher
A taxi races through the city streets
A cat jumps across rooftops in the city
